featured_reviews.name: Jignesh Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I cannot thank Trisha Patel enough for the incredible support and guidance she provided during a very difficult phase of my life. As both an Architect and a Vastu Consultant, she brings a rare combination of practical knowledge and deep insight.

For over six months, I was struggling with ongoing challenges—particularly financial—and despite trying everything, nothing seemed to improve. Honestly, I was quite skeptical about Vastu and wasn’t sure if it could really make a difference. But out of sheer desperation, I decided to consult Trisha.

She reviewed the house drawings and immediately identified areas that needed correction. She was clear in her guidance and mentioned that the effects might take a bit of time. However, to my surprise, within just two weeks of implementing the changes she recommended, I started noticing a real shift—especially in my financial situation.

Trisha’s deep understanding of Vastu and her calm, clear approach gave me a sense of direction and relief. I now genuinely believe that House Vastu can be a powerful tool to align our living spaces with our inner energies. If you're feeling stuck or out of balance, I wholeheartedly recommend reaching out to Trisha. Her guidance can truly be life-changing.

name: Tushar Chhatbar Architects
description:
Tushar Chhatbar Architects is multi disciplinary firm. We enjoy a 360 degree approach right from master planning to the smallest product details. We want to build something that can stay relevant in the perspective of time.
Our work operates within the cultural context of the country and yet suggests that each project is a product of cultural mutation and reinvention. We try and maintain the spirit of each location, desire of people and attempt to integrate the real, imaginary and symbolic with ease. Our work questions the political and ethical responsibility of the contemporary Indian designer and is concerned with its public consequences.
We aim for simplicity, conceptual rigors and material invention.
